This piece's same formula gives 1.6328, 1.6925, 1.6347, 1.6945. Equation 2.2-14 over P0 gives 1.0634, 1.0909, 1.0681, 1.0958. The buckling gap is kc = 1 - vc/4 while vc is below 2. kc is 0.6771, 0.6701, 0.6764, 0.6693. It is set at model61.py line 106 and model63.py line 113 and multiplies the buckling allowable at model61.py line 120 and model63.py line 127. Pressure is P0*max(1.01, QWEATHER)+QWIND at model61.py line 99 and model63.py line 106. QWIND and QWEATHER are model63.py lines 21-23, with no handbook citation in the file. It accounts for the move from the nu 0.33 margins 1.6328, 1.6925, 1.6347, 1.6945 to the model-nu margins 1.5459, 1.6024, 1.5476, 1.6043, and it does not bring either set to 1. Gamma 0.20 and Q 0.33 stand, from CR-1457 as COMMON and knockdown.md state them, with the named hemisphere and waviness limits. kc, the cure coefficients, 11.3e-6, the 1.01 floor, QWIND and QWEATHER have no equation in the opened model text, the SOURCE-INDEX bodies, knockdown.md, or COMMON.md. The 040 case source string names pinned 014b. That pin is not in the SOURCE-INDEX and was not opened. Those four unsourced terms are removed one at a time. BETA stays 1. Vc itself is not replaced.
